g.text: window control: one 8k-context trace, 24 vs 64 steps (slope 4.74 %p)

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The window points are a control: one context at two observation lengths differs only in how much of the pre-populated batch has left.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Expect scatter in the middle. The two families reach a given dead fraction by different routes — a running steady state versus a batch draining once —

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 7px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: so they need only meet at 0 and at 100%. Tight agreement mid-range would be the suspicious outcome, not the reassuring one.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Each family sits a constant distance above the identity — 0.0026 for churn, 0.0010 for the window control. Restored to bytes through each run's own base HBM,

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: both are one tile: 1.016 MiB and 1.031 MiB. The offset is the replay's 1 MiB granularity, not a mechanism, which is why it must be quoted in bytes rather than in %p.

text.style: fill: #898781; font: 6.8px 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Trace replay, not a measurement. Raw values in outputs/dead_kv_generalization.csv.
